name: labs/aics-int__microscope_automation
title: Zeiss ZEN blue microscope (microscope_automation ConnectMicroscope)
intro: Zeiss ZEN blue microscope (microscope_automation ConnectMicroscope), adapted from aics-int/microscope_automation. It reads `stage_x`, `stage_y`, `objective_name`, `objective_position` and 2 more; runs `live_mode_start`, `live_mode_stop` and `snap_image`. `live_mode_start`: start ZEN live mode for an experiment (the active experiment when none is named). A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
